summary: Phase 1 (Core Records & Ingestion) end-to-end verified against live preview. Backend: project suite (45/45 pass via pytest.aegis.ini) + agent suite (12/12 pass, /app/backend/tests_agent/test_phase1_review.py). Agent suite covers: 8-user login (/api/v1/auth/provider -> exactly 8 dev_accounts), 4 seeded systems LTP/MPP/FMDH/TRS listed, LTP metrics.assigned_controls == 291 (moderate + demo-cloud-overlay), new moderate system registered as ISSM via POST /api/v1/systems -> 287 assigned (no overlays), leadership_viewer POST /systems -> 403, GET /systems/{id}/sources returns MOCK/DEMO adapter_mode on non-file connectors with NO secret_ciphertext leaked, duplicate upload loop (/systems/{id}/uploads 202 queued -> poll /ingest-runs/{id}): identical SHA-256 re-upload -> status 'duplicate', content+XML-comment modified copy -> status 'completed', workbench control detail exposes all four separate statuses (implementation_status / assessment_status / monitoring_status / evidence_freshness_status), /systems/{id}/evidence/verify 202 as platform_admin, ISSO /demo/evidence/{id}/collected-at -> 403, /dashboard/leadership 200 for leadership_viewer/ao/issm and 403 for isso, /systems/{id}/assets and /systems/{id}/roles 200 for ISSO. Frontend (Playwright): login page shows exactly 8 dev-user-option-* buttons; isso login lands /controls; /systems lists LTP (291 assigned), MPP (370), FMDH (287), TRS (149), plus the newly registered Agent Moderate (287); LTP detail page shows the '291' control workbench button, asset inventory (15), system-scoped roles table; /evidence-sources shows 6 cards (ACAS/Nessus ok, AWS GovCloud Config MOCK/DEMO ok, Annual Security Awareness Attestation MOCK/DEMO ok, DISA STIG Checklists ok, GitLab DevSecOps Pipeline MOCK/DEMO ok, eMASS MOCK/DEMO disabled) each with Test connection / Run collection / View evidence buttons, Latest ingest table shows the two duplicate-labeled runs and the completed modified-copy run with SHA-256 and controls-touched; /portfolio for ISSO renders red 'Missing permission: portfolio.read' message; for leadership_viewer renders Systems=5/Authorized=3/In assessment=1/Open CAT I=3/Open KEV=1/Evidence fresh=100% KPI tiles + system-risk table + trend chart (8 synthetic / 19 live snapshots). Sidebar phase badges verified: POA&M=P2; Inheritance/Policy Auditor/Reviews/RMF Workflow=P3; Portfolio/Systems/Evidence Sources/Controls/Evidence Ledger/Admin have no badge.

critical_code_review_comments: All Phase 1 acceptance criteria pass. Backend contracts are consistent and well-typed; evidence sources omit secret_ciphertext from responses (credential_set bool only) which satisfies the 'credentials never returned' requirement. Worker-based async ingestion correctly produces three distinct outcomes (queued->completed, duplicate, failed) and the duplicate path reuses the original run_id for finding/observation display. STIG CCI mapping and ACAS KEV mapping provenance both verified via run_detail findings.mappings[].provenance.
Minor doc drift between /app/memory/test_credentials.md and app/security/rbac.py on portfolio.read for platform_admin — see action item above.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contract notes for Phase 1 (differs from the review-request shorthand): systems use 'acronym' (not 'short_name'); POST /api/v1/systems body requires baseline_key in {low,moderate,high} plus optional overlay_keys/tailoring/include_privacy; control-assignment count is exposed on GET /systems and GET /systems/{id} as metrics.assigned_controls (no separate /control-assignments endpoint); evidence source list is /systems/{id}/sources with adapter_mode='mock' for non-file connectors and credential_set:bool with secret_ciphertext stripped; upload is POST /systems/{id}/uploads (multipart file + Form 'source_id'), returns 202 with run dict (poll /ingest-runs/{id}); workbench control detail at /systems/{id}/workbench/controls/{control_id} returns implementation_status / assessment_status / monitoring_status / evidence_freshness_status; evidence verify at /systems/{id}/evidence/verify; demo back-date at /demo/evidence/{evidence_id}/collected-at (platform_admin only); portfolio at /dashboard/leadership; admin reset at /admin/demo/reset. Project pytest MUST use `-c pytest.aegis.ini` (uses aegisrmf_test DB). Agent integration tests use default pytest.ini which has `-n 2 --dist loadscope` in addopts; run serial with `-n 0`. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://aegis-rmf-demo.preview.emergentagent.com .
